name: New Okhla Industrial Development Authority
summary: The body that planned and runs the city of Noida, including its wide internal roads and expressways.
about: Noida was built from farmland on a plan, which is why its roads are unusually wide and laid out in a grid of numbered sectors. The authority allots the land, lays the roads and services, and maintains them afterwards. The Noida–Greater Noida Expressway is its best-known road, connecting the older city to Greater Noida and on to the Yamuna Expressway.
facts: Set up in 1976 to build a planned industrial city across the river from Delhi.
Built the Noida–Greater Noida Expressway, which links onward to the Yamuna Expressway.
Pays for roads and services largely by selling the land it develops.
